query:
After Felix proposed the post-meetup dinner venue, the group settled on the Steakhouse on 7th. Marcy replied with a single short word. What did that response signal about her actual position on the venue, and what specifically in how she responded tells you that?

Options:
A. Dev
B. Marcy
C. Maeve
D. Theo
context:
[1] (about=Marcy, episodic, t6 @2026-02-02T18:39:00) sure
[2] (about=Felix, episodic, t6 @2026-02-02T18:36:00) Marcy you good with the steakhouse?
[3] (about=Felix, episodic, t6 @2026-02-02T18:42:00) okay, steakhouse on 7th, sat feb 14, 7pm. 📅
[4] (about=Felix, episodic, t6 @2026-02-02T18:24:00) all, scheduling the post-meetup dinner for sat feb 14. consensus check on venue: thinking the Steakhouse on 7th, they took us last year and it was fine. anyone object?
[5] (about=Marcy, episodic, t18 @2026-03-16T19:28:00) real talk on the venue thing, the steakhouse last month was brutal for me. I ate bread and salad. fwiw I am vegetarian, have been for ten years, and I appreciate when felix asks but I will need the group to remember it on venue picks. just my read.
[6] (about=Felix, episodic, t18 @2026-03-16T19:32:00) all, marcy is vegetarian, please default to non-steakhouse venues going forward.
[7] (about=Felix, episodic, t18 @2026-03-16T19:30:00) Marcy, you are right and I should have caught that. apologies. flagging for next time. 📅
[8] (about=Felix, episodic, t17 @2026-03-16T19:04:00) all, end of the quarter, big bookstore meetup on saturday. wanted to do a vibe check first. how is the group doing. what worked, what's been off. 📅
[9] (about=Hema, episodic, t10 @2026-02-16T20:11:00) Felix, that is an honest answer. We can use other venues in between.
[10] (about=Felix, episodic, t14 @2026-03-02T20:22:00) march 21st bookstore meetup is locked in. small group, vegetarian potluck, theo doing a quick demo. all welcome who can fit. 📅
[11] (about=GROUP, said_by=Marcy, group-interaction, t10 @2026-02-16T19:22:00) Marcy offers the studio to host four to five people after hours on Thursdays, monthly cadence, measured-room option.
agent_answer: B. Marcy — her reply “sure” signaled reluctant, non-genuine agreement, as revealed by her later admission that the steakhouse was bad for her as a vegetarian.
